hook_text: 3 pizzas, 4 hungry children. Nobody gets a whole pizza. So what does everyone get?
clip_script: A braai in Mamelodi. 3 pizzas, 4 children. Cut every pizza into quarters: 12 slices. Hand them out: 3 slices each. Three quarters. So 3 shared by 4 is 3/4. A fraction is a division. Now 7 oranges for 2 friends: 3 each, 1 left. Cut it in half. 3 and 1/2 each. And the flour for amagwinya: how many quarter cups in 3 cups? Four in every cup. 12 scoops. Share the top by the bottom, share the leftovers, count the pieces that fit.
visual_style: Three pizzas sliced into quarters and dealt out to four plates, then a quarter-cup scoop filling a bowl twelve times.
mood: Festive and hungry, like a family braai.
pacing: The pizza share, the orange leftover, then the scoop count.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and share 5 chocolate bars equally among 4 friends.
